hymns.title: My beginning and my ending
verses:
My beginning and my ending
Deeply rooted in Jesus
He is author and Finisher
Of my faith and everything

Chorus:
I will follow him
I will march for him
To Jesus, Saviour,
Commander
Shout Hallelujah

My past, present and my future
My all in all, traced to him
While in mother's womb
He knew me
In His hands my whole picture
(Repeat Chorus)

My past He has cleansed
With his blood
So that now I'm white as snow
My healings I owed to His stripes
He has made me truly whole
(Repeat Chorus)

All my needs today he supplies
Body, soul and in spirit
There's a table prepared for me
In the presence of my foes
(Repeat Chorus)

He gives me strength
For succeeding
I can do exploits for Him
He who opened up the Red sea
He has opened ways for me
(Repeat Chorus)

I can walk and not be tired
I can run and not be weary
I can soar with wing as eagle
From now to eternity
(Repeat Chorus)

Whatever my Situation
My tomorrow is alright
In the hands of the omega
Things can only get better
(Repeat Chorus)

I know glory is ahead of me
Christ in me, hope of glory
He has made me righteous in God
So, it will be well with me
(Repeat Chorus)

I will sing praises to Jesus
Praises to God, the Father
Praises to God, Holy spirit
Hallelujah, Trinity
(Repeat Chorus)

hymns.title: I'll pass safe through rivers
verses:
I'll pass safe through rivers
Deep as rivers can be
God is with me

Chorus:
Glory ahead for me
'Cos Jesus lives in me
I'm more than conqueror
Hallelujah

I'll pass safe through fire
Hot as fires can be
God protects me
(Repeat Chorus)

I know that winds will blow
It 'll lift me higher still
God uplifts me
(Repeat Chorus)

If Goliath arise
He'll end under my feet
God fights for me
(Repeat Chorus)

Family foes may try
They can't win over me
God surrounds me
(Repeat Chorus)

I sure will overcome
By the blood of the Lamb
Strong evermore
(Repeat Chorus)

Whatever is my case
My testimony is
God reigns in me
(Repeat Chorus)

Table is set for me
Mockers gather and see
God loves me so
(Repeat Chorus)

My anointing will flow
Until it overflows
God treasures me
(Repeat Chorus)

Surely goodness, mercy
Will always follow me
God won't leave me
(Repeat Chorus)

I will praise you my God
Father, Son, Holy Ghost
I'll sing and shout
(Repeat Chorus)

Hallelujah, today
Hallelujah, ever
Hallelujah
(Repeat Chorus)

hymns.title: There is a type of Joy (Joy Unspeakable)
verses:
There is a type of Joy
So Great, it is Unspeakable
It is full of Faith and Glory
It is to You available

Chorus:
Great Joy
Joy so Great Unspeakable
Great Joy
Joy so Great Unspeakable
Great Joy
Great Joy
And it is mine
Hallelujah

It is beyond Joy of Healings
It is Joy money can not buy
Beyond Joy of Fruitful Weddings
It is to You available
(Repeat Chorus)

Not Joy of Career Success
Beyond Joy of Fame and Progress
Not Joy of early Achievements
It is to You available
(Repeat Chorus)

It is the Joy of Salvation
The Joy of Eternal Life
The Joy of Divine Communion
It is to You available
(Repeat Chorus)

The Joy of Knowing God Himself
Ability to hear His Voice
One day to see Him face to face
It is to You available
(Repeat Chorus)

There's a Joy, Oh Yes, there is Great joy
There's Joy Exceedingly Great Joy
There's Joy known as Fullness of Joy
It is to You available
(Repeat Chorus)

One Day in the bye and bye soon
Jesus will Return for His Own
Glories of Heaven He will bring
It is to You available
(Repeat Chorus)

Weepers will never again
Death, Sorrows will all Pass away
It will be Joy Unspeakable
It is to You available
(Repeat Chorus)

Glory to God our Great Father
Glory to Jesus our Saviour
To Holy Spirit, Comforter
Glory to Blessed Trinity
(Repeat Chorus)

hymns.title: Jesus is friend of Children
verses:
Jesus is friend of Children
Let them come to me He said
Never forbid my good friends
He loves me and I love Him

Chorus:
Jesus is my Lord
Jesus is my friend
He loves me ever
I shout Hallelujah

Great friendship is found in Him
He is Alpha Omega
He's by my side forever
He loves me and I love Him
(Repeat Chorus)

Greatest love is found in Him
He gave His life for sinners
While in sins He died for us
He loves me and I love Him
(Repeat Chorus)

The whole earth belongs to Him
All the silver all the gold
He is richer than my dad
He loves me and I love Him
(Repeat Chorus)

All powers belong to Him
Both in heaven and on earth
He is stronger than all dads
He loves me and I love Him
(Repeat Chorus)

Greatest joy is found in Him
Not in any earthly toy
When I cry He gives me joy
He loves me and I love Him
(Repeat Chorus)

Greatest wisdom is in Him
He knows more than all teachers
Through Him I can be brighter
He loves me and I love Him
(Repeat Chorus)

One day I will be with Him
In His home above the sky
But today He is my guide
He loves me and I love Him
(Repeat Chorus)

Hallelujah to father
Hallelujah God the son
Hallelujah God Spirit
Praise the Lord, Hallelujah
(Repeat Chorus)

hymns.title: I will end up shouting glory
verses:
I will end up shouting glory
Glory to God forever
Whenever He speaks it is done
His counsel stands forever

Chorus:
Glory be to God Holy Father
Glory to Jesus Christ forever
Glory to blessed Holy Spirit
join me shout Hallelujah

I will end up shouting glory
Glory to God forever
He says His thoughts towards me is good
My destiny is settled
(Repeat Chorus)

I will end up shouting glory
Glory to God forever
He says my tomorrow is ok
I will never be ashamed
(Repeat Chorus)

I will end up shouting glory
Glory to God forever
With Him fighting all of my battles
More than winner I will be
(Repeat Chorus)

I will end up shouting glory
Glory to God forever
With Him supplying all of my needs
I can never never lack
(Repeat Chorus)

I will end up shouting glory
Glory to God forever
He will still all the storms on my way
And give me peace every day
(Repeat Chorus)

I will end up shouting glory
Glory to God forever
He loves me more than I can deserve
All of my praise He deserves
(Repeat Chorus)

I will end up shouting glory
Glory to God forever
He built a mansion for me above
In dad's compound in heaven
(Repeat Chorus)

I will end up shouting glory
Glory to God forever
One day will come I will reign with Him
Seated with Him on His throne
(Repeat Chorus)

hymns.title: Jesus knew me
verses:
Jesus knew me (2ce)
Before I was formed (2ce)
He wished me well (2ce)
Before I was born (2ce)

Chorus:
Jesus loved me
Before I came forth
Jesus chose me
Before I knew Him
(So) I will rejoice
I will rejoice
And be glad in Him

Jesus saved me (2ce)
From the pit of sin (2ce)
He rescued me (2ce)
From the jaws of death (2ce)
(Repeat Chorus)

He died for me (2ce)
So that I may live (2ce)
He went to hell (2ce)
So I won't go there (2ce)
(Repeat Chorus)

He was beaten (2ce)
So I can be healed (2ce)
Took many stripes (2ce)
So I can be whole (2ce)
(Repeat Chorus)

He became poor (2ce)
So I can be rich (2ce)
Supply my needs (2ce)
By His poverty (2ce)
(Repeat Chorus)

He made me free (2ce)
Because I know Him (2ce)
He is the truth (2ce)
His truth set me free (2ce)
(Repeat Chorus)

He gives me hope (2ce)
Hope of great glory (2ce)
He destined me for (2ce) greatness indeed (2ce)
(Repeat Chorus)

I Know one day (2ce)
I will make heaven (2ce)
Reigning with Him (2ce)
In true royalty (2ce)
(Repeat Chorus)

Hallelujah (2ce)
Jesus Christ is Lord (2ce)
Hallelujah (2ce)
Jesus is my Lord (2ce)
(Repeat Chorus)

hymns.title: Blessed Jesus, the Alpha, Omega
verses: Theme: Destined for Greatness (3). Tune: "Abide with me, fast falls the evening tide"

Blessed Jesus, the Alpha, Omega
Known unto You, my end from beginning
I love You Lord, my Saviour and Helper
My Healer, Provider and Deliverer

Before You formed me in my mother's womb
You had purpose for my being in the world
A role to play, assignment to perform
Something You want me do for Your pleasure

Now I am here to do Your perfect will
Thy will, not mine, be done, in all my life
Your word my law, your commands I'll obey
Every day of my life from day to day

I need Your help to fulfill destiny
My power and might will not carry me through
My strength my will falter on the way
Send help to me my God show me mercy

Send me angels among the heavenly hosts
Send Your prophet, send Your anointed one
Open my sea, let Your great East wind blow
I'll shout Hallelujah let all walls fall

Send human beings, be it a poor widow
Or someone rich, someone with great influence
Be a servant, a help in my household
Controller of all beings, send help to me

Send help to me, Maker of destiny
Send help to me, Guide of my destiny
Send help to me, Beginning and the End
Send help to me, perfect my destiny

Send help to me, I'll sing Hallelujah
Send help to me, Author and Finisher
Send help to me, my Maker, my father
Send help to me, I'll shout Hallelujah

Hallelujah to You God the Father
Hallelujah to Jesus Christ the Son
Hallelujah to blessed Holy Ghost
Hallelujah, amen, Hallelujah.

hymns.title: Let us Praise now our Lord Jesus
verses: Tune: "When we will get to Heaven"

Let us Praise now our Lord Jesus
For Salvation of our Souls
Our sins red as Crimson before
He has made now White as snow.

Chorus:
Let us Praise the Lord Jesus
Let us serve Him with all of our Souls
He has made us Victors
Let us sing and Hallelujah shout

Let us Praise now our Lord Jesus
For our Healing and our Health
He rescued us from Jaws of Death
By His Stripes we've been made whole.
(Repeat Chorus)

Let us Praise now our Lord Jesus
For our Freedom from all Yokes
Once we were bound by Satan's Yokes
His Blood gave us Victories
(Repeat Chorus)

Let us Praise now our Lord Jesus
For Provision for our Needs
He became Poor to make us rich
To have Life Abundantly.
(Repeat Chorus)

Let us Praise now our Lord Jesus
For ending our Helplessness
We were weak but now we are Strong
His Strength ensures our Success.
(Repeat Chorus)

Let us Praise now our Lord Jesus
For making us Powerful
His Spirit has empowered us
His Presence will see us through.
(Repeat Chorus)

Let us Praise now our Lord Jesus.
Over Mountains, over Hills
We will soar on His Eagle's Wings
We will end Strong, Victorious
(Repeat Chorus)

Let us Praise now our Lord Jesus
Let us Praise our coming King
In Him we live, move, have our Being
We are Sure Overcomers
(Repeat Chorus)

Let us do what they do in Heaven
Like Elders before His Throne
At His Feet let's lay down our Crowns
Give Glory to Him alone
(Repeat Chorus)

hymns.title: I Trust Jesus My Great Saviour
verses:
I Trust Jesus My Great Saviour
He Will Remember Me
He Saved My Soul from Going to Hell
He Shed His Blood for Me

Chorus:
God Gave Me His Begotten Son
What Else Can He Not Give Me
He Will Surely Remember Me
I'll Shout Hallelujah

I Trust Jesus My Redeemer
He Will Remember Me
He Defeated Satan for Me
He Conquered Death and Hell
(Repeat Chorus)

I Trust Jesus My Great Healer
He Will Remember Me
He Took Great Stripes for My Healing
By His Stripes I Am Healed
(Repeat Chorus)

I Trust Jesus My Provider
He Will Remember Me
He Became Poor So I'll Be Rich
He'll Supply All My Needs
(Repeat Chorus)

I Trust Jesus My Creator
He Will Remember Me
Anything Wrong with My System
He Will Repair for Free
(Repeat Chorus)

I Trust Jesus the Word of God
He Will Remember Me
His Word Will Heal, Deliver Me
He'll Send His Word to Me
(Repeat Chorus)

I Trust Jesus the Fruitful Vine
He Will Remember Me
He Is the Vine, I Am the Branch
He Will Make Me Fruitful
(Repeat Chorus)

I Trust Jesus, Head of The Church
He Will Remember Me
He Is the Groom, I Am the Bride
Together We Succeed
(Repeat Chorus)

I Trust Jesus the Coming King
He Will Remember Me
He Will Soon Come to Take Me Home
Fruitful And Triumphant
(Repeat Chorus)

Hallelujah To My Jesus
hallelujah My King
hallelujah My Beloved
hallelujah My Lord
(Repeat Chorus)

He's a wonder
My God is a wonder
He's a wonder
My God is a wonder
He's a wonder
Jesus is a wonder
He's a wonder
Holy spirit wonder

He's the alpha
My God is a wonder
He's omega
My God is a wonder
The Beginning
My God is a wonder
Never ending
My God is a wonder

He lives ever
My God is a wonder
Changing never
My God is a wonder
Present ever
My God is a wonder
Faithful ever
My God is a wonder

He made all things
My God is a wonder
He feed all things
My God is a wonder
He knows all things
My God is a wonder
He rules all things
My God is a wonder

He's my maker
My God is a wonder
He's my Saviour
My God is a wonder

My God is a wonder
He's my healer
My God is a wonder

My Defender
My God is a wonder
My provider

Hallelujah

hallelujah

hymns.title: My beloved, your time is come
verses: Tune: "Ho, My Comrades, see the Signal"

My beloved, your time is come
You will soon rejoice
Your great turnaround bid welcome
Make a joyful noise

Chorus:
Let us sweet Hallelujah sing
To the King of kings
To the One who lives in power
Shout Hallelujah

Are you asking when to be healed?
The answer is now
The Great Healer's hand to you stretched
Now not tomorrow
(Repeat Chorus)

Are you wondering when to be free?
The answer is now
Lord of hosts had issued decree
"Let My people go"
(Repeat Chorus)

Asking when you will fruitful be?
End to all failures
Jesus says, "Just abide in Me"
Much success is yours
(Repeat Chorus)

Are you burdened with cares, sorrows?
No rest and no peace
Commander of storms and billows
Says, "now be at ease"
(Repeat Chorus)

Looks as if you have lost all hope?
Your bones are now dry
The wind of the Spirit will blow
You'll begin to fly
(Repeat Chorus)

Are you drifting far from heaven?
Jesus says, "Return"
Come to Me and be forgiven
There is hell to shun
(Repeat Chorus)

Are you thirsty for God's power?
Million souls to win
Holy Spirit, your great Partner
Beckons you to drink
(Repeat Chorus)

Are you working for God's kingdom?
No rewards till now
God is true and in His wisdom
Your rewards start now
(Repeat Chorus)

Looking for your heaven's mansion
Your Groom will soon come
As He promised He'll return soon
He'll take you to home
(Repeat Chorus)

Join me sing sweet Hallelujah!
That is my new song
Let us shout great Hallelujah!
For great turnaround
(Repeat Chorus)

hymns.title: My time has come for Victory
verses: Theme: The God of All Flesh. Tune: "O Happy Day"

My time has come for Victory
Over problems Physically
God of all Flesh will heal my flesh
Sufficiently to make me whole

Chorus:
Hallelujah
My time has come
Waiting is gone,
Winning is now
Victory
From now on
God of all Flesh
Is by my side

My time has come for Victory
Over problems Materially
God of all Flesh will meet my needs
Sufficiently to make me rich
(Repeat Chorus)

My time has come for Victory
Over problems Maritally
All loneliness and barrenness
Will now be gone permanently
(Repeat Chorus)

My time has come for Victory
Over problems Spiritually
All yokes will go, Bondages gone
God's anointing will make me free
(Repeat Chorus)

My time has come for Victory
Over problems in Emotions,
No more weeping, No more mournings
No more sorrow, No more groaning
(Repeat Chorus)

My time has come for Victory
Over problems known and unknown
Mountains will move and walls will fall
The sea will part to let me pass
(Repeat Chorus)

My time has come for Victory
Over problems of Stagnation
My promotion will be rapid
Physically, Spiritually
(Repeat Chorus)

My time has come for Victory
Over problems of Lukewarmness
I will be hot for my Saviour
I will serve Him more than before
(Repeat Chorus)

My time has come for Victory
Over problems of thanklessness
I will praise God more than before
His Praise shall be loud in my mouth
(Repeat Chorus)

Halleluyah will be my Song
Halleluyah will be my Shout
Halleluyah to You my God
God of all Flesh - Halleluyah.
(Repeat Chorus)
